scenes.name: TWO COSINES
lines: Take three unit vectors, A, B and C, and fix two cosines: A with B, and B with C.
取三根单位向量 A、B、C，先定下两条余弦：A·B 与 B·C。
Then C is no longer free. It can only circle around B.
于是 C 不再自由：它只能绕着 B 转一圈。

scenes.name: GRAM WINDOW
lines: As C goes round, the third cosine swings between two edges.
C 转一圈，第三条余弦 A·C 在两道边之间来回摆动。
The middle is the product of the two cosines; the half-width is the product of the two sines.
窗口的中点是两条余弦之积 cos θ₁ cos θ₂，半宽是两个正弦之积 sin θ₁ sin θ₂。
At sixty and forty-five degrees, the window runs from the cosine of a hundred and five degrees to the cosine of fifteen.
θ₁ = 60°、θ₂ = 45° 时，窗口从 cos 105° 到 cos 15°。

scenes.name: VOLUME
lines: The three arrows span a solid. Its volume squared is the Gram determinant.
三根箭头撑开一块立体，它的体积平方就是格拉姆行列式 det G。
Swap the letters and it reads the same: no vector comes first.
三个字母任意对调，式子一字不变：谁也不在谁之前。
Inside the window it is positive. At an edge it is zero, and the three lie in one plane.
窗口内部 det G > 0；贴上窗边时 det G = 0，三根向量落进同一个平面。
Ask for a cosine outside, and it turns negative. No three unit vectors can do that.
想要窗外的余弦，det G 就成了负数：没有任何三根单位向量做得到。

scenes.name: ELLIPSE
lines: Now let the second angle run from zero to a hundred and eighty degrees.
现在让第二个角 θ₂ 从 0° 走到 180°。
Each window is one vertical slit. Together they fill an ellipse.
每个窗口是一道竖缝，合起来铺满一个椭圆。
Its rim is the two addition tracks: the cosine of theta one minus theta two on top, and of theta one plus theta two below.
椭圆的边是两条余弦加法轨线：上沿 cos(θ₁ − θ₂)，下沿 cos(θ₁ + θ₂)。

scenes.name: OVERLAP ONE
lines: Where theta two equals theta one, the top edge touches one.
θ₂ = θ₁ 处，上沿碰到 1。
An overlap of one means the two unit vectors are equal: C lands on A.
两根单位向量的内积等于 1，当且仅当它们相等：C 落在 A 上。
Lean has checked this, and that overlap one is an equivalence relation.
这一条已由 Lean 内核检验，“内积等于 1”还是一个等价关系。
Two cosines lock the third, and no clock ticks anywhere.
两条余弦锁住第三条，其间没有任何时钟在走。

scenes.name: LEDGER
lines: Geometric Intuition of Quantum Computing, chapter twenty-nine.
《量子计算的几何直觉》· 第二十九章
